title: Rust: decapsulate IPv6-in-IPv6 in plaintext Stack::receive path
description: b7z9.4.2 wired egress decap into the RPL receive path (receive.rs, both Absent local-delivery and SRH-consumed branches) but not Stack::receive (rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs:527-584). There the survey now admits nh=41 packets addressed to the local address and hands the still-encapsulated outer to upper layers (which ignore it). Stack lacks local_rpl_addr; expected_dst could be the already-computed local_native (lichen_core::addr::ygg_addr_from_pubkey) if that is the authorized primary 02xx for that path. Reuse rpl_stack::util::decapsulate_ipv6. Add unit tests mirroring tests.rs decapsulate cases.
